_note: v2 hook overrides for la Passerelle des Liens (ST_liens, S16_park). Every hook describes what is actually painted (nothing is written in the paintings): Monsieur Verbe the striped mime acts out each verb; the hand mirror marks a reflexive verb; périr and mutiler are shown only as blank museum plaques.

fr_cramponner_verb.why: Crampons → se cramponner (à) = to cling (to). The hand mirror shows it is reflexive: il SE cramponne à la rampe. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_joindre_verb.why: Wand → joindre = to join; also to reach someone (by phone). GOLD beret = irregular (je joins, nous joignons).

fr_brancher_verb.why: Branch → brancher = to plug in. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_relier_verb.why: Rely → relier = to link (un pont relie les deux villages). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_connecter_verb.why: Connect → connecter = to connect; the example's se connecter = to log in. The card teaches plain connecter, so no mirror is painted. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_convier_verb.why: Convey → convier = to invite (nous sommes conviés). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_boiser_verb.why: Boa → boiser = to afforest, plant trees; also to panel in wood, like the paneled cabins of the alley. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_profiler_verb.why: Profile → profiler = to profile, outline; the example's se profiler = to be outlined against the horizon. The card teaches plain profiler, so no mirror is painted. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_centraliser_verb.why: Central → centraliser = to centralize, gather everything in the middle. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_generaliser_verb.why: General → généraliser = to generalize (il ne faut pas généraliser). Used plainly here, so no mirror. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_raccorder_verb.why: A CORD → raccorder = to join, connect (pipes, wires). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_articuler_verb.why: Articulate → articuler = to articulate, speak clearly. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_collaborer_verb.why: Collar / collaborate → collaborer = to collaborate. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_cohabiter_verb.why: COW + BEE + habit → cohabiter = to live together. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_subvenir_verb.why: Souvenir → subvenir (à) = to provide for. GOLD beret = irregular (like venir: il subvient).

fr_eprendre_verb.why: A PRAWN → s'éprendre (de) = to fall for, become enamored with. The hand mirror shows it is reflexive: il S'EST épris. GOLD beret = irregular (like prendre).
